build_detection_train_loader: build a DensePose training data loader from a Detectron2 config node with an optional custom dataset mapper
build_detection_test_loader: build a DensePose test data loader for a named dataset using batch size 1 and test-time transforms
combine_detection_dataset_dicts: combine and merge dataset dicts from multiple datasets with category ID mapping and instance filtering
build_inference_based_loader: build an inference-based data loader that uses model predictions to bootstrap training data with sampling and filtering
build_data_sampler: build a prediction-to-ground-truth data sampler supporting uniform, confidence-based, and CSE sampling strategies
